data.dailyActionAtTime: Listening to the cassette tape player and watching who enters the service stairwell. (West Parlor Lounge)
data.userMessage: I brought the vintage jazz records and antique brass keys you mentioned.
data.agentReply: *My shoulders drop, the sharp edge of my suspicion softening as I glance at the treasures in your hand.* Perhaps... perhaps I was too quick to judge your temperament, for the weight of these keys and the promise of a warm jazz record are enough to soothe even the most unsettled nerves in this drafty hotel. Behind the Room 202 fireplace wainscoting, there is a pivoted brass latch that opens directly into the hidden service shaft; just be careful, for the walls here hold secrets that prefer to remain buried in the dust.
data.gameplayInfluenceSummary: Mentioned liked topic (antique brass keys, jazz records) → Tenant warmed up to CORDIAL (Trust 74/100)
